title: Writer React Parity
description: Get writer's react renderer to premigration level (git tag `premigration`, where writer/react/index.tsx was a 1542-line React renderer with WriterCanvas: jack AST tree, selectable spans, symbol occurrences/rename, placeholders, newline gating, completions, context menu, keyboard navigation, window measures/engagement, toolbar) on the migrated Rust plugin architecture: writer/plugin/rs emits a TextEditorScene UiTree interpreted by framework/renderer/react's text-editor-host.tsx, backed by the framework/editor/rs GPU editor session. Follow the approach of PUZZLE-2D-REACT-PARITY and PUZZLE-3D-REACT-PARITY (26/07/09).
summary: Fixed the reported bug: selecting an example in the writer app did nothing. Root cause #1: writer/plugin/rs/lib.rs never handled the "setActiveExample" command the host dispatches from the example dropdown (os-shell.tsx) — it silently no-op'd. Added a handler that loads jack/dag.jack/empty by id and resets runtime state, with 3 new unit tests and a dedicated wasm-verify.ts repro against the real compiled component. Root cause #2 (found while chasing why loaded content still didn't render): a pre-existing bug in the shared GraphWasmCanvas component (infinite/cavas/react-renderer/index.tsx, used by all wasm-editor-session hosts, not writer-specific) — it attached the WebGPU canvas synchronously using the container's live layout rect with only a 1px floor, so on first paint (and guaranteed again on React 18 StrictMode's dev-mode remount) it reliably attached at 1x1; WebGPU surface errors are async/out-of-band so this failed silently with no thrown exception, permanently blanking that session. Cleanup also never called detachGpu(). Fixed by adding a waitForLayout rAF-poll before the first attach (mirrors premigration's waitForLayoutSize helper) and wiring detachGpu() into cleanup; also caught and fixed my own regression in the first draft of this fix (dropped the canvas.width/height sizing that must happen before attachCanvas). Verified deterministically end-to-end: 27 Rust unit tests (writer-plugin), 18 (framework_editor) + 7 (framework_core), 69 vitest cases, cargo check clean on wasm32-wasip2, tsc clean on all changed files, and wasm-verify.ts passing against the actual compiled writer_plugin.js/wasm including a direct repro of the original bug. A live browser click-through could not be cleanly completed: the shared dev server was undergoing a full page reload every ~7-10s from other concurrent sessions repeatedly saving massive shared files (os-shell.tsx, ui/js/react/index.tsx), which structurally prevents any client app from staying mounted long enough to finish a GPU attach+paint cycle — this is an environmental condition outside this ticket's control, documented in verify-log.md along with a manual checklist for a follow-up session once things settle.
